# Known concrete types must not ask the runtime for type identity. The
# ejected generic instances contain no dynamic identity helper calls.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^static identity compiled out$'
logos eject -o out
! grep 'DynamicTypeDifference' out/main.go
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
stdout '^static identity compiled out$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/staticidentity

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"logos/expect"
)

type reporter struct{}

func (r *reporter) Helper() {}
func (r *reporter) Errorf(format string, args ...any) { panic(fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }

type record struct {
	Name string
	Count int
}

func main() {
	r := &reporter{}
	v := record{Name: "same", Count: 7}
	p := &v
	expect.Equal(r, v, v)
	expect.Equal(r, 7, 7)
	expect.Equal(r, p, p)
	fmt.Println("static identity compiled out")
}
